decisions.reason: The operator line is a heavily invested, publicly featured pillar of the one-source garage door offering, so management will keep it despite not being observed on the website in 2020 to 2021, attributing the reduced visibility to website restructuring rather than failure.

As part of the core industrial door range with shared tooling and sunk development, the glazed sectional door is kept, though its low visibility makes it a somewhat likelier candidate for consolidation.
The insulated glazed variant fits the firm's announced thermal and energy-efficiency direction, which justifies persistence even with weak visibility.
Having been launched prominently on its own page, the firm has publicly committed to this door, and its sunk costs and place in the industrial range favor continuing it.
